preamble.title: mrg16/pvc2-settlement
preamble.description: P3S1-R1 research successor (PROPOSED, unreviewed, uncompiled): MRG16-PVC ABI v2 thread settlement with all-account authority, Core owner-intent bridge (cardano intent domain /2), C2-parameterized S2, structural shape cell order and named gate components. Not adopted; not a ledger or proof result.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

anyOf.title: Custody
anyOf.description: Balance held in the thread UTxO.

anyOf.title: External
anyOf.description: Off-thread account; payouts go to this full address (payment + stake credential).

pvc2/types/AccountV2.title: AccountV2
pvc2/types/AccountV2.description: P3-2 (CHANGE text, two votes): every account carries debit authority.

fields.title: native
fields.description: Optional native co-authority required in addition to the signed intent.

fields.title: advancers
fields.description: Thread-advance authority: if non-empty, one of these accounts must sign the step.

pvc2/types/AssetIdV2.title: AssetIdV2
pvc2/types/AssetIdV2.description: Core `AssetId { network, issuer, reference, scale }` (scale is a u8).

pvc2/types/AssetMapV2.title: AssetMapV2
pvc2/types/AssetMapV2.description:
P3-1: exactly one Cardano unit per mapped Moriarty asset, factor 10^exp with exp >= 0.
 `unit = None` is unmapped: no physical leg, custody rows must stay 0.

pvc2/types/DeclV2.title: DeclV2
pvc2/types/DeclV2.description: A declaration `(name, ty)`: ty 0 = UInt, 1 = Bool.

pvc2/types/DutyRowV2.title: DutyRowV2
pvc2/types/DutyRowV2.description: A present liability row (present-zero rows included).

pvc2/types/IntentKeyV2.title: IntentKeyV2
pvc2/types/IntentKeyV2.description: Core owner-intent key: BIP-340 x-only (32 bytes) or compressed SEC1 (33 bytes).

pvc2/types/PayoutDatumRule.title: PayoutDatumRule
pvc2/types/PayoutDatumRule.description: Datum rule for payouts to an external address.

anyOf.title: PinnedDatum
anyOf.description: Inline datum equal to this pinned Data (script destinations).

fields.title: balances
fields.description: Custody rows, strictly ascending by (AssetId, account).

fields.title: liabilities
fields.description: Present rows, strictly ascending by name.

pvc2/types/ValueV2.title: ValueV2
pvc2/types/ValueV2.description: A Moriarty `/1` value. UInt values must lie in [0, 2^128).
